rationale: The agent verified identity via the provided email matching a single user account, then fetched and reviewed all orders. They correctly identified eligible actions (cancel pending, return delivered), asked for explicit confirmation including the cancellation reason before making any changes, and then executed the cancellations and return requests via the appropriate tools. The tool results confirm both pending orders were cancelled with refunds to the gift card and that returns were requested for all items from the delivered orders with refunds to the original gift card upon completion. The agent’s final summary aligns with the tool outputs and policies. No actions were taken without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported claims were made beyond standard return-process messaging. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
